code.title: Code
code.description: authentication_failed | forbidden | password_change_required | not_found | conflict | validation_failed | rate_limit_exceeded | http_error | internal_error

details.title: Details
details.description: Present only on request-validation failures (HTTP 422 with code 'validation_failed' from malformed input); one entry per invalid field. Input values are never echoed back.

field.title: Field
field.description: Dotted path of the invalid field, e.g. 'priority'.

unrestricted.title: Unrestricted
unrestricted.description: True for the Owner, who holds every permission.

MyPermissionsResponse.title: MyPermissionsResponse
MyPermissionsResponse.description:
The caller's own permission configuration, for permission-aware UI.

Display hints only - the server enforces every rule regardless. Evaluation order
is explicit deny > explicit allow > reporting hierarchy > role default
(docs/permissions.md section 5).

must_reset.title: Must Reset
must_reset.description: True while the account has a temporary/admin-set password. The server rejects every endpoint except /auth/me, /auth/change-password and /auth/logout with 403 `password_change_required` until the password is changed.

UserUpdateRequest.title: UserUpdateRequest
UserUpdateRequest.description:
manager_id is deliberately not editable here - see
POST /hierarchy/{user_id}/manager, which is the single code path for
reassigning a user's manager (it also runs the cycle-prevention and
closure-table-maintenance triggers and its own audit action).
